shiftNote: Anchored to a 7:00 AM shift with recording from 8:00 AM. Other shifts keep the same sequence.

day.text: Anyone who cannot make tomorrow's shift has called and messaged their Portfolio Manager by now.

Operators clock the devices out at the pickup location. They count the phones and log the number, check every battery, confirm every wearer is logged into their own account, and check that last night's upload finished.
Thirty-minute cycles. Wearers work their assigned task; no phones, no breaks while the cycle runs. When a cycle ends, the operator restarts it.
At every 30-minute reset the operator looks at what was just recorded: the angle, the lighting, the wearer still working. Problems get fixed on the spot.
Devices returned, inspected, and docked to charge. Nothing sleeps holding more than one day of footage.
The Portfolio Manager goes through everything the site recorded today, before it uploads. Anything that should not go out is pulled here.
Every Portfolio Manager sends hours, active phones, hardware status, problems, and fixes to Mano.
Adham, Moharam, and Mano review every site, reallocate, and clear escalations.
Any operator can bring an idea, a problem, or a question about their growth straight to leadership.
The founders read the day's consolidated total. Below target means a same-night call, not a next-morning conversation.
The phones upload overnight at the hub, over fiber.
Two reviewers on the quality control team watch every video. If either one says delete, it is deleted. It counts only when both accept it. Flags reach the Portfolio Manager the same day.

week.note: Client update. Adham sends it; Mano supplies the numbers.
Full flush of every device before the day off. Factory phones to a hub.
Day off in Egypt. Hotels only, on their own lines.

weekly: Book review: each Portfolio Manager against target, once a week.

month.text: Beat last month and the book grows. Miss twice and it shrinks.
Youssef Medhat runs the audit passes. Flagged footage is deleted.
The invoice goes out on accepted hours only.
Payroll, site payments, referral and performance bonuses through Mano.

items: Thursday: full flush of every device before the Friday day off, and a Friday plan for sites that keep running
Sunday: Adham sends the client update; Mano supplies the numbers
Book review: each Portfolio Manager against target
Books re-earned: beat it and it grows, miss twice and it shrinks
Month-end audit passes by Youssef Medhat before the invoice goes out
Payroll, site payments, referral and performance bonuses through Mano
Absences by 10 PM the night before, or it counts as a no-show
One account per person, never shared, never recycled
Three flags pulls a worker; a second strike pauses the device
Nobody names the client, to anyone, for any reason
